rationale: P identifies braking occurrence and its intended or unintended character, which must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking under SG-3. Its operational scope matches H-3. Braking behaviour itself is the subject of the target, rather than merely a mechanism affecting evaluation. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing requirements.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” identifies the system behaviour directly addressed by the evaluation target and H-3.
“Whether braking occurs and whether it is intended or unintended” captures the property required to evaluate SG-3.
The declared scope—straight-ahead urban driving at 50 km/h, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, in good weather—matches the operational situation supplied in H-3.
No observation, control-chain, warning, redundancy, or timing mechanisms are incorporated into P.
